package fixture

import (
	stdcontext "context"
	t "metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// Import aliases must be resolved by import path, not by the source spelling
// of the package name.
func badActorFromCtxAliased(ctx stdcontext.Context) (string, string, error) {
	_, _ = t.FromContext(ctx)
	return "", "", nil
}
